title: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
description: Grilled chicken skewers served with a creamy peanut sauce. This dish is a classic Malaysian street food.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, peanut butter, soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger paste, garlic paste, and satay spice blend. Blend until smooth.
2. Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
3. Pour the peanut sauce into the saucepan and bring to a simmer.
4. Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Meanwhile, cut the chicken breast into 1-inch pieces.
6. Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
7. Brush the chicken with a little vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
8. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
9. Grill the chicken skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
10. Serve the grilled chicken with the peanut sauce for dipping.
11. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
